panel.title: Commission briefs
panel.subtitle: One link that hands palette, references and requirements to an artist
panel.intro: A brief is a snapshot taken when you create it: character profile, palette, the references you pick and this commission's requirements, with bilingual text and a one-page sheet. Editing the fursona later does not change briefs you already sent. No AI image generation is used.
panel.needMedia: Upload at least one processed image to the gallery first
panel.regenerateAsk: The old link stops working immediately. Continue?
panel.empty: No briefs yet. Create one to get a /c/ link you can paste straight to an artist.

create.title: Create a commission brief
create.description: Pick references (ordered by click) and fill in this commission's requirements. Every field is optional.
create.pickOne: Pick at least one reference image
create.nsfwNote: Includes NSFW content: the whole brief will be marked NSFW and cannot be opened by visitors or users without age confirmation.
create.footerNote: Text is generated from a template; palette and credits are raw data.
